sprichwoerter.text: The early bird catches the worm.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you start early, you have an advantage.

sprichwoerter.text: Actions speak louder than words.
sprichwoerter.sub: = What you do is more important than what you say.

sprichwoerter.text: A stitch in time saves nine.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Fix a small problem now, before it becomes a big one.

sprichwoerter.text: Rome wasn’t built in a day.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Big things take a long time.

sprichwoerter.text: Practice makes perfect.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You get better when you do something again and again.

sprichwoerter.text: Better late than never.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to arrive or start late than not at all.

sprichwoerter.text: Don’t count your chickens before they hatch.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Don’t be sure of something good before it has happened.

sprichwoerter.text: Don’t put all your eggs in one basket.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Don’t risk everything on one thing.

sprichwoerter.text: Too many cooks spoil the broth.
sprichwoerter.sub: = When too many people work on something, it goes wrong.

sprichwoerter.text: Where there’s a will, there’s a way.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you really want something, you will find a way.

sprichwoerter.text: All’s well that ends well.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If the end is good, the problems on the way do not matter.

sprichwoerter.text: Look before you leap.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Think about it before you act.

sprichwoerter.text: You can’t judge a book by its cover.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You cannot know what something is like from how it looks.

sprichwoerter.text: Two wrongs don’t make a right.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Doing something bad back to someone does not help.

sprichwoerter.text: The grass is always greener on the other side.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Other people’s lives often look better than ours.

sprichwoerter.text: Every cloud has a silver lining.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Even a bad situation has something good in it.

sprichwoerter.text: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A real friend helps you when you have problems.

sprichwoerter.text: Birds of a feather flock together.
sprichwoerter.sub: = People who are alike spend time together.

sprichwoerter.text: Don’t cry over spilt milk.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Don’t be sad about something that has already happened.

sprichwoerter.text: Easy come, easy go.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Things you get easily, like money, are also easy to lose.

sprichwoerter.text: Honesty is the best policy.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is always best to tell the truth.

sprichwoerter.text: If it isn’t broken, don’t fix it.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If something works well, don’t change it.

sprichwoerter.text: It takes two to tango.
sprichwoerter.sub: = In a quarrel, both people are responsible.

sprichwoerter.text: Many hands make light work.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A job is easy when many people help.

sprichwoerter.text: No pain, no gain.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You must work hard to get good results.

sprichwoerter.text: Out of sight, out of mind.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You forget people and things that you do not see.

sprichwoerter.text: The pen is mightier than the sword.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Words can do more than fighting.

sprichwoerter.text: There’s no place like home.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Home is the best place to be.

sprichwoerter.text: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
sprichwoerter.sub: = In a new place, do things the way people do them there.

sprichwoerter.text: You can’t have your cake and eat it.
sprichwoerter.sub: = You cannot have both things. You must choose.

sprichwoerter.text: A picture is worth a thousand words.
sprichwoerter.sub: = A picture can show more than a long text.

sprichwoerter.text: Beggars can’t be choosers.
sprichwoerter.sub: = If you need help, you must accept what you get.

sprichwoerter.text: Curiosity killed the cat.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Asking too many questions can bring trouble.

sprichwoerter.text: Don’t bite the hand that feeds you.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Don’t be unkind to someone who helps you.

sprichwoerter.text: Fortune favours the brave.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Brave people are often lucky.

sprichwoerter.text: Laughter is the best medicine.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Laughing makes you feel better.

sprichwoerter.text: Slow and steady wins the race.
sprichwoerter.sub: = Going slowly but without stopping brings success.

sprichwoerter.text: The best things in life are free.
sprichwoerter.sub: = The most important things do not cost money.

sprichwoerter.text: Better safe than sorry.
sprichwoerter.sub: = It is better to be careful than to have a problem later.
